title: Directory Replication Rights Granted On The Domain Object
detection_hypothesis: If an adversary prepares domain-wide credential replication, the domain object security descriptor will be modified to include a replication control access right.

field_semantics.EventID: Numeric identifier of the Windows event record.
field_semantics.AttributeLDAPDisplayName: Directory attribute affected by the change.
field_semantics.AttributeValue: Value written to the directory attribute.

collection_prerequisites: The relevant advanced audit policy subcategory is enabled for success events.
Domain controller Security logs are forwarded for directory-scoped events.
expected_collection_gaps: Events raised on a domain controller that is not forwarding logs are invisible.
Security log wrapping on busy controllers can drop events before forwarding.
normalization_assumptions: EventID is an integer and Channel is the literal string Security.
Account names are provided without the domain prefix in TargetUserName.
ingestion_differences: Some pipelines rename EventID to event.code or similar.
Directory attribute events may arrive with XML-encoded values.
retention_considerations: Security log volume varies widely; 180 to 365 days is common for identity events.
expected_volume: Rare; expected only during planned directory changes.
false_positive_strategy: The benign population is limited to controller promotion and connector installation, both of which are planned and rare. Verify the granted principal against the domain controllers group and the connector account inventory.
tuning_guidance: Do not create standing exclusions. Instead, suppress during a documented promotion window and require the granted principal to be reviewed afterwards.
test_strategy: Positive cases grant each of the two replication control access rights. Negative cases modify the descriptor without a replication right, modify another attribute, and read the descriptor.
unmapped_defensive_objects_reason: No Detection Strategy, Analytic, or Data Component identifier for this technique was present in the pinned ATT&CK extraction used by this lab. Defensive arrays are left empty rather than populated with unverified identifiers. Unmapped techniques: T1003.006.
author: Salvatore Mazzaglia
